steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each critical spare is placed by its stock against its minimum and whether an order is open.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 critical spare is below minimum with no order

findings.title: Critical spare below minimum with no order
Lead time with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the lead time

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] spare-seal.md:12  Critical spare below minimum with no order.
       Fix: Order the spare now.
[medium] spare-sensor.md:19  Lead time with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the lead time.
[low] spare-filter.md:26  Spare with no minimum set.
       Fix: Set the minimum.
Not checked: Supplier reliability.
pros: Checks a critical spare below its minimum with no order, and a lead time with no source.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ind-spares-check skill on the records for this review.
